product_title: Royal Peacock Eye Toran with Krishna Motis (38 inches)
product_description: Add a vibrant traditional touch to your entrance with this handcrafted toran, featuring colourful peacock-eye motifs, a charming Lord Krishna centerpiece, intricate golden detailing, and elegant pearl and shell-style tassels. Perfect for Diwali, Janmashtami, pooja rooms, weddings, and festive home décor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearls, tassels, and embellishments carefully.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
